episodes.synopsis: While Ash, Pikachu, and Aipom head toward the Sinnoh region, where lots of new adventures await them, a young Trainer named Dawn is just beginning her own Pokémon journey.
episodes.title: Following a Maiden's Voyage!

episodes.synopsis: As Dawn sets off to find an injured Pikachu's Trainer, Ash hears the story from Professor Rowan and sets off to find Dawn-and reunites with Brock along the way!
episodes.title: Two Degrees of Separation!

episodes.synopsis: As Ash and Brock finally meet up with Dawn and are reunited with Pikachu, a Trainer named Paul challenges Ash to a battle.
episodes.title: When Pokémon Worlds Collide!

episodes.synopsis: Dawn has her very first battle with Nando, a Pokémon bard who's torn between two possible paths on his journey.
episodes.title: Dawn of a New Era!

episodes.synopsis: After Team Rocket makes off with Ash's Pikachu once again, a feisty Turtwig appears to rescue Pikachu and later takes a bit of time to warm up to our heroes.
episodes.title: Gettin' Twiggy with It!

episodes.synopsis: After showing up again seemingly out of nowhere, Paul is pitted against Ash in a series of battles that reflect just how different they are as Trainers and people.
episodes.title: Different Strokes for Different Blokes!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Jubilife City and Dawn's first Pokémon Contest, Piplup decides to help a group of Pokémon in need.
episodes.title: Like It or Lup It!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come across a phony Pokémon Gym run by a disguised Team Rocket, who are plotting to steal as many Pokémon as they can!
episodes.title: Gymbaliar!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes discover a Buneary in the forest on the way to Jubilife City, and Dawn decides she just has to catch it!
episodes.title: Setting the World on Its Buneary!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes arrive in Jubilife City for Dawn's first Pokémon Contest, they run into some fake Pokétch peddlers with an evil scheme!
episodes.title: Not on MY Watch Ya Don't!

episodes.synopsis: Ash decides to join Dawn in their very first Pokémon Contest, and Dawn finds a new friend and rival in a fellow Coordinator named Zoey!
episodes.title: Mounting a Coordinator Assault!

episodes.synopsis: The Jubilife City Pokémon Contest is in full swing! Can Ash and Dawn make it to the finals? And what will happen if they face each other?
episodes.title: Arrival of a Rival!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Oreburgh City, our heroes discover that something is happening to the flying Pokémon who live in the forest, and they decide to investigate.
episodes.title: A Staravia Is Born!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes help an injured Nuzleaf, Team Rocket tries to steal it-and ends up nabbing Brock in the process!
episodes.title: Leave It to Brocko!

episodes.synopsis: When Ash arrives at the Oreburgh Gym for his first Gym battle in the Sinnoh region, he discovers that his rival Paul has beaten him to the challenge!
episodes.title: Shapes of Things to Come!

episodes.synopsis: After Paul's victory at the Oreburgh Gym, it's Ash's turn to face Gym Leader Roark and his powerful Rock-type Pokémon.
episodes.title: A Gruff Act to Follow!

episodes.synopsis: When a Team Rocket scheme unleashes ancient Pokémon upon Oreburgh City, our heroes must pitch in to round them up!
episodes.title: Wild in the Streets!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is back at the Oreburgh Gym for a rematch with Roark-who has a newly evolved Rampardos on his team! Can our hero win his first Sinnoh Gym badge?
episodes.title: O'er the Rampardos We Watched!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes travel toward Dawn's next Pokémon Contest in Floaroma Town, she catches an adorable Pachirisu-who might turn out to be more than she can handle!
episodes.title: Twice Smitten, Once Shy!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes encounter the ruthless Pokémon Hunter J, they are forced into an unusual alliance to deal with the threat!
episodes.title: Mutiny in the Bounty!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come across two Trainers who are dedicated to their unevolved Pokémon-and must protect them when Team Rocket is determined to steal those Pokémon and make them evolve!
episodes.title: Ya See We Want an Evolution!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come across an unofficial Pokémon Contest in a small village-and after an unusual good deed, Team Rocket's Jessie wants to borrow Ash's Aipom to compete!
episodes.title: Borrowing on Bad Faith!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Dawn's next Pokémon Contest in Floaroma Town, our heroes come across a village of Bidoof whose safety is threatened by a rampaging Steelix!
episodes.title: Faced with Steelix Determination!

episodes.synopsis: When the elderly Abigail's Pikachu goes missing, Ash's Pikachu reluctantly agrees to fill in until Abigail's niece can locate the missing Pokémon.
episodes.title: Cooking Up a Sweet Story!

episodes.synopsis: Dawn convinces Ash and Brock to join her in a cooking class, where they learn how to make Pokémon snacks called Poffins-and meet the fascinating Pokémon Roserade!
episodes.title: Oh Do You Know the Poffin Plan!

episodes.synopsis: As she prepares for the Pokémon Contest in Floaroma Town, Dawn gets a surprise visit from her childhood friend Kenny!
episodes.title: Getting the Pre-Contest Titters!

episodes.synopsis: In the Floaroma Pokémon Contest, Dawn finds herself facing off against not only "Jessilina" but also her old friend Kenny!
episodes.title: Settling a Not-So-Old Score!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Eterna City, our heroes meet an unusual Nurse Joy who has a family: two little girls who want to be just like their mom!
episodes.title: Drifloon on the Wind!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet twin Trainers who have won 15 Tag Battles in a row-and the boys challenge Ash and Dawn to battle number 16!
episodes.title: The Champ Twins!

episodes.synopsis: In the Eterna Forest, our heroes meet a treasure hunter named Cheryl who's on a mission to discover the Amber Castle, which holds a special Enchanted Honey!
episodes.title: Some Enchanted Sweetening!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes help treasure-hunter Cheryl with her quest for the Enchanted Honey, they meet a Trainer named Gardenia who adores Grass-type Pokémon.
episodes.title: The Grass-Type Is Always Greener!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes, along with treasure-hunter Cheryl, discover a mysterious cave that might hold the answers to the Enchanted Honey they've been looking for!
episodes.title: An Angry Combeenation!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes discover the Pokémon Dress-Up Contest, a unique event where Pokémon compete by disguising themselves as other kinds of Pokémon!
episodes.title: All Dressed Up with Somewhere to Go!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Eterna City, our heroes meet up with Dawn's friend and contest rival Zoey-plus an impressive Buizel that Dawn would love to catch!
episodes.title: Buizel Your Way Out of This!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes run into Lucian, a member of the Sinnoh region's Elite Four, who agrees to help Dawn train her new friend Buizel.
episodes.title: An Elite Meet and Greet!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes arrive in Eterna City for Ash's next Gym battle, they witness the aftermath of a major theft at the local museum of history!
episodes.title: A Secret Sphere of Influence!

episodes.synopsis: Ash challenges Gym Leader Gardenia, a Grass-type expert who defeated him in battle when they first met in Eterna Forest! Can he come out on top this time?
episodes.title: The Grass Menagerie!

episodes.synopsis: When Brock's Pokémon Egg starts to hatch, our heroes make a fateful stop at a run-down Pokémon Center along the Cycling Road.
episodes.title: One Big Happiny Family!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes board a steamboat headed to Hearthome City-but when they have to run back into town for supplies, the boat accidentally takes off with their Pokémon!
episodes.title: Steamboat Willies!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Hearthome City, our heroes cross paths with Cynthia, the Champion of the Sinnoh League-and she's battling Ash's rival Paul!
episodes.title: Top-Down Training!

episodes.synopsis: When Dawn runs into an injured Zoey on the way to Hearthome City, she learns about a whole new style of contest that uses two Pokémon at once!
episodes.title: A Stand-Up Sit-Down!

episodes.synopsis: At a Pokémon Training Center, our heroes meet a Pokémon Breeder who's having some difficulty with his powerful but undisciplined Electrike.
episodes.title: The Electrike Company!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes pass through a mysterious gate and are sent to a strange place where all their dreams seem to be coming true-courtesy of a mischievous Mismagius!
episodes.title: Malice in Wonderland!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes rescue a terrified Hippopotas who's gotten stranded on a ledge, and they set off to return their new friend to its herd.
episodes.title: Mass Hip-Po-Sis!

episodes.synopsis: Ash unexpectedly runs into Gary Oak, his old rival from Kanto, and the two Trainers team up to protect a rare Shieldon from Pokémon Hunter J!
episodes.title: Ill-Will Hunting!

episodes.synopsis: When Dawn decides to take a detour to upgrade her Pokétch, our heroes find themselves in a maze of Team Rocket's making!
episodes.title: A Maze-Ing Race!

episodes.synopsis: A Trainer named Mira offers to send our heroes straight to Hearthome City using her Abra's Teleport move, but first she needs them to do her a favor.
episodes.title: Sandshrew's Locker!

episodes.synopsis:
A clip show unaired outside of Japan summarizing the important events of the first 47 Diamond and Pearl episodes, including Satoshi's (Ash's) victories over Hyouta (Roark) and Natane (Gardenia), and the introductions of new rivals Shinji (Paul) and Nozomi (Zoey).

On their way to Hearthome City, Ash, Dawn and Brock recall their adventures together so far.
episodes.title: Satoshi and Hikari! Facing a New Adventure!!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Hearthome Contest! Dawn faces some stiff competition: her rival Zoey, Pokémon bard Nando, and Team Rocket's Jessie are all determined contenders!
episodes.title: Dawn's Early Night!

episodes.synopsis: Right on the heels of the Pokémon Contest, Ash, Dawn, and Brock all decide to enter Hearthome City's Tag Battle Competition, where teams of two Trainers face off!
episodes.title: Tag! We're It...!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has been paired up with his rival Paul for the Tag Battle Competition-but Paul is pushing his Chimchar way too hard!
episodes.title: Glory Blaze!

episodes.synopsis: The Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition is coming to an exciting conclusion, as all of our heroes are set to face each other in the last few rounds!
episodes.title: Smells Like Team Spirit!

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Veilstone City and Ash's next Gym battle, a trio of angry Zangoose force Chimchar to face its fearful past.
episodes.title: Tears for Fears!

episodes.synopsis: James must decide whether to keep his beloved Cacnea or allow it to train and grow strong with Gardenia, the Eterna Gym Leader.
episodes.title: Once There Were Greenfields

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes draw closer to Ash's next Gym battle and Dawn's next Pokémon Contest, they consider the pros and cons of a Pokémon trade!
episodes.title: Throwing the Track Switch

episodes.synopsis: Continuing on their way to Solaceon Town and then Veilstone City, our heroes accidentally free a mean-spirited Spiritomb from the keystone that had held it captive for 500 years.
episodes.title: The Keystone Pops!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Solaceon Town, our heroes run into a worried stonecutter who's working on a stone bridge that must be completed within three days. Can they help her?
episodes.title: Bibarel Gnaws Best!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends come across a feisty young Trainer named Alan, whose newly evolved Probopass is Team Rocket's latest target!
episodes.title: Nosing 'Round the Mountain!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Solaceon Town, our heroes meet a young detective who is struggling to cope with her angry Luxray.
episodes.title: Luxray Vision!

episodes.synopsis: Arriving in Solaceon Town, site of Dawn's upcoming Pokémon Contest, our heroes come across Team Galactic in the process of stealing a valuable treasure guarded by a group of Unown.
episodes.title: Journey to the Unown!

episodes.synopsis: The Solaceon Pokémon Contest is finally under way! Can Dawn and her newly evolved Ambipom take on her old friend Kenny and "Jessilina"?
episodes.title: Team Shocker!

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Veilstone City for Ash's next Gym battle, our heroes stop at a Maid Café, where one of the owners is having some trouble with her Miltank.
episodes.title: Tanks for the Memories!

episodes.synopsis: Dawn introduces our heroes to her old friend Leona, whose family runs a hotel built around a hot spring. Unfortunately, business seems to be drying up.
episodes.title: Hot Springing a Leak!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes find themselves in a sprawling city that has been overrun by a group of lost Gligar and their leader Gliscor.
episodes.title: Riding the Winds of Change!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Veilstone City, our heroes must cross a desert, where they meet a massive Hippowdon-a friend of the Hippopotas they once rescued!
episodes.title: Sleight of Sand!

episodes.synopsis: When they arrive in Veilstone City, our heroes face several important challenges-but Ash's long-awaited Gym battle isn't one of them!
episodes.title: Lost Leader Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: In an attempt to help Gym Leader Maylene through her crisis of confidence, Dawn issues a challenge. It's Dawn's very first Gym battle!
episodes.title: Crossing the Battle Line!

episodes.synopsis: Veilstone Gym Leader Maylene is back in action and ready to accept Ash's challenge for his third Sinnoh region Gym badge!
episodes.title: A Triple Fighting Chance!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are all set to head out toward their next destination when the mysterious Team Galactic appears, with an evil plot to establish a new world!
episodes.title: Enter Galactic!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Pastoria City, our heroes meet a Pokémon magician with a trio of singing Chingling that have caught Team Rocket's eye!
episodes.title: The Bells Are Singing!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet Pokémon Ranger Kellyn, who's on a mission to help a very special Riolu return to its home.
episodes.title: Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (1)

episodes.synopsis: After stealing Riolu for her latest client, Pokémon Hunter J must face Top Ranger Kellyn and our heroes as they attempt to return Riolu to its home!
episodes.title: Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (2)

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket is hot on the trail of our heroes when Jessie's Dustox has an encounter that leaves her with a tough decision!
episodes.title: Crossing Paths

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Pikachu meet an unusual Trainer who would really like to add a Pikachu to his team of Pichu and Raichu!
episodes.title: Pika and Goliath!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes learn about the Wallace Cup, a prestigious Pokémon Contest hosted by Contest Master Wallace-and then Dawn unexpectedly gets to meet the man himself!
episodes.title: Our Cup Runneth Over!

episodes.synopsis: As they prepare for the Wallace Cup, our heroes meet someone else who's getting ready for the same event: Ash and Brock's friend May, from the Hoenn region!
episodes.title: A Full Course Tag Battle!

episodes.synopsis: It's the first stage of the Wallace Cup, and Ash, May, Dawn, and Zoey are all competing! Can all four of them make it to the next round?
episodes.title: Staging a Heroes' Welcome!

episodes.synopsis: The second round of the Wallace Cup has arrived, and Dawn, Ash, May, and Zoey are all in the victory hunt!
episodes.title: Pruning a Passel of Pals!

episodes.synopsis: Dawn faces the prospect of battling against her rival Zoey or her new friend May in the final round of the prestigious Wallace Cup!
episodes.title: Strategy with a Smile!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Pastoria City, our heroes meet a beginning Trainer named Tyler, who's trying to catch his first wild Pokémon.
episodes.title: The Thief That Keeps on Thieving!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes encounter Ash's rival Paul outside Pastoria City, Chimchar-who joined Ash's team after Paul left it behind-is itching for a battle!
episodes.title: Chim-Charred!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes arrive in Pastoria City and meet Gym Leader Crasher Wake, who introduces them to the annual Croagunk Festival!
episodes.title: Cream of the Croagunk Crop!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Ash to go up against Pastoria City Gym Leader Crasher Wake in an attempt to win his fourth Sinnoh region Gym badge!
episodes.title: A Crasher Course in Power!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are heading back to Hearthome City so Ash can challenge the Gym Leader there when they meet a very hungry wild Swinub who's causing problems for its neighbors!
episodes.title: Hungry for the Good Life!

episodes.synopsis: After being defeated by Paul, Ash's Gligar wants to do some special training-and they find an unexpected ally to help!
episodes.title: Fighting Fear with Fear!

episodes.synopsis: After they learn that the Hearthome City Gym Leader is still away, Ash and Dawn discover a different kind of competition to keep them busy!
episodes.title: Arriving in Style!

episodes.synopsis: Following a narrow ravine on their way to Celestic Town, our heroes find themselves blocked by a trio of determined and powerful Psyduck.
episodes.title: The Psyduck Stops Here!

episodes.synopsis: Professor Rowan invites our heroes to participate in his Pokémon Summer Academy, where Trainers are randomly paired with Pokémon so they can learn to work together!
episodes.title: Camping It Up!

episodes.synopsis: At Pokémon Summer Academy, our heroes are working on a report about the Water-type Pokémon in a nearby lake when a mystery begins to unfold!
episodes.title: Up Close and Personable!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes continue their studies at Pokémon Summer Academy, where a close encounter with Ghost-type Pokémon proves challenging for Ash and his new rival Angie!
episodes.title: Ghoul Daze!

episodes.synopsis: Pokémon Summer Academy is drawing to a close, and that means it's time for all the students to participate in the Pokémon Triathlon!
episodes.title: One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team!

episodes.synopsis: Dawn and Piplup are getting serious about their training-maybe too serious. Meanwhile, the Team Rocket trio are trying to get back in shape after their cushy Summer Academy job.
episodes.title: A Lean Mean Team Rocket Machine!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Celestic Town, our heroes run into two people they didn't expect to see: Dawn's rival Zoey, battling the elusive Hearthome City Gym Leader, Fantina!
episodes.title: Playing the Leveling Field!

episodes.synopsis: When Brock goes to run an errand, Ash and Dawn suddenly find themselves dealing with a very sick Pachirisu-and their usual doctor isn't in the house!
episodes.title: Doc Brock!

episodes.synopsis: While competing in the Celestic Town Pokémon Contest, Dawn meets a Coordinator of legend: one who once defeated Top Coordinator Johanna, Dawn's mom!
episodes.title: Battling the Generation Gap!

episodes.synopsis: The evil Team Galactic is back on the scene once again, this time to steal the Adamant and Lustrous Orbs!
episodes.title: Losing Its Lustrous!

episodes.synopsis: As Team Galactic continues its evil quest to steal the Lustrous Orb, Champion Cynthia and our heroes discover they must battle both Team Galactic and Team Rocket to protect it!
episodes.title: Double Team Turnover!

episodes.synopsis: Taking some time off to visit their friend Angie on their way to Hearthome City, our heroes investigate the mystery of the Scarf Monster!
episodes.title: If the Scarf Fits, Wear It!

episodes.synopsis: A surprise encounter with Aaron, a member of the Elite Four, gives our heroes the unique opportunity to witness an emotional reunion between Aaron and his first Pokémon.
episodes.title: A Trainer and Child Reunion!

episodes.synopsis: While Ash is training for his rematch with Fantina at the Hearthome Gym, his rival Paul interrupts him for a battle!
episodes.title: Aiding the Enemy!

episodes.synopsis: On the eve of Ash's long-awaited rematch against Fantina at the Hearthome Gym, a confident new rival suddenly appears to challenge our hero!
episodes.title: Barry's Busting Out All Over!

episodes.synopsis: After two previous visits to her empty Gym and an unexpected battle on the road, Ash finally gets to challenge Gym Leader Fantina in Hearthome City!
episodes.title: Shield with a Twist!

episodes.synopsis: After an explosion separates Trainers and Pokémon, Meowth entertains the idea of quitting Team Rocket and joining up with our heroes!
episodes.title: Jumping Rocket Ship!

episodes.synopsis: Traveling through Canalave City, our heroes come across an island where everyone is mysteriously having restless nights and nonstop nightmares!
episodes.title: Sleepless in Pre-Battle!

episodes.synopsis: After hearing about a delicacy called Old Gateau, our heroes pay a visit to the Old Chateau, where it's made, and encounter some spooky surprises!
episodes.title: Get Your Rotom Running!

episodes.synopsis: As Dawn trains in preparation to enter the Chocovine Pokémon Contest with her Piloswine, she is caught off guard by the challenges that present themselves.
episodes.title: A Breed Stampede!

episodes.synopsis: Canalave Gym Leader Byron is back in town, and our heroes are all fired up for Ash's battle with him-only to discover that it's going to have to wait!
episodes.title: Ancient Family Matters!

episodes.synopsis: The day of Ash's battle with Byron at the Canalave Gym has arrived, and battling with this Gym Leader is something Ash will never forget!
episodes.title: Dealing with Defensive Types!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes find a group of Wailord blocking the boat that was to take them to Chocovine Town, Ash discovers an ailing Wailmer with a big problem!
episodes.title: Leading a Stray!

episodes.synopsis: After rushing to Iron Island to help out their friend Barry and his struggling Empoleon, our heroes discover that all the island's Steel-type Pokémon are in the same state!
episodes.title: Steeling Peace of Mind!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have joined forces with Riley and his Lucario to battle Team Galactic for the fate of Iron Island!
episodes.title: Saving the World from Ruins!

episodes.synopsis: After being kidnapped by Team Rocket, Pikachu and Piplup are stranded on a deserted island, where they meet a lot of friendly Pokémon-and one that's friendly and mysterious!
episodes.title: Cheers on Castaways Isle!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes discover that Chocovine Town is one of the few places where the rare Pokémon Phione can be seen!
episodes.title: Hold the Phione!

episodes.synopsis: The day of the Chocovine Contest has finally arrived, and Dawn is faced with an opponent angrily determined to settle an old score!
episodes.title: Another One Gabites the Dust!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Snowpoint City and Ash's next Gym battle, our heroes come across a most unusual Officer Jenny and her buddy Chatot!
episodes.title: Stealing the Conversation!

episodes.synopsis: After getting lost in a blinding snowstorm on their way to Snowpoint City, our heroes come across a Froslass desperate to find its lost pal Snorunt.
episodes.title: The Drifting Snorunt!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes and Team Rocket find themselves in a gourmet noodle shop, a chain of circumstances leads to a Team Rocket breakup!
episodes.title: Noodles! Roamin' Off!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Snowpoint City and Ash's next Gym battle, our heroes make a stop in Squallville for a Pokéringer competition-a special event for flying Pokémon!
episodes.title: Pursuing a Lofty Goal!

episodes.synopsis: Continuing toward Snowpoint City, our heroes come across a fierce Aggron who provides Dawn and Mamoswine with a chance to learn and grow together.
episodes.title: Trials and Adulations!

episodes.synopsis: The friends travel toward Snowpoint City.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Creatures, Pocket Monsters!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Snowpoint City and Ash's next Gym battle, our heroes discover a lonely Snover who offers Grotle an unexpected gift!
episodes.title: The Lonely Snover!

episodes.synopsis: As Dawn prepares for her entry into the Sandalstraw Contest, something appears to be wrong with Piplup-and this ends up profoundly affecting Dawn and Piplup's relationship!
episodes.title: Stopped in the Name of Love!

episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the Sandalstraw Pokémon Contest, and Dawn and her old friend and rival Kenny are going head to head!
episodes.title: Old Rivals, New Tricks!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes decide to participate in the Pokémon Ping Pong competition, Ambipom's exceptional talent presents Dawn with an exceptional dilemma!
episodes.title: To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!

episodes.synopsis: Stopping at Shelter Town on their way to Snowpoint City, our heroes meet a young girl who judges all Pokémon by their cuteness!
episodes.title: Battling a Cute Drama!

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in Snowpoint City and meeting up with Dawn's rival Zoey, our heroes discover that Snowpoint Gym Leader Candice also teaches at the Pokémon Training School!
episodes.title: Classroom Training!

episodes.synopsis: The moment of Ash's Snowpoint City Gym battle is finally here, and he now must face Candice and her formidable Pokémon!
episodes.title: Sliding into Seventh!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes run into their old friend Brandon from the Battle Pyramid-and Ash's rival Paul, who challenges Brandon to a battle on the spot!
episodes.title: A Pyramiding Rage!

episodes.synopsis: The evil Pokémon Hunter J and her henchmen are on the loose again, and this time they're planning to capture the Legendary Pokémon Regigigas!
episodes.title: Pillars of Friendship!

episodes.synopsis: On their way by rail to Lake Acuity and Ash's scheduled battle with Paul, a mysterious train stop prompts a fellow passenger to secretly spring into action!
episodes.title: Frozen on Their Tracks!

episodes.synopsis: The time for the 6-on-6 full battle between Ash and Paul has arrived, and Paul's well-thought-out strategy has Ash struggling!
episodes.title: Pedal to the Mettle!

episodes.synopsis: The 6-on-6 full battle between Ash and Paul is raging on at Lake Acuity when a sudden development turns things upside down!
episodes.title: Evolving Strategies!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is feeling pretty down after losing to Paul, but another Team Rocket attempt to steal Pikachu brings Ash and his Pokémon together like never before!
episodes.title: Uncrushing Defeat!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Lilypad Town and Dawn's next Pokémon Contest, our heroes come across an amazing Tangrowth whose concern for its forest home is causing strange things to happen!
episodes.title: Promoting Healthy Tangrowth!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Lilypad Town and Dawn's next Pokémon Contest, an event called the Sinnoh Pokémon Hustle intrigues our heroes! But all is not as it seems.
episodes.title: Beating the Bustle and Hustle!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes find a lost Shellos on the wrong side of Mt. Coronet and vow to take it back home, they discover the evil Team Galactic's latest dastardly operation!
episodes.title: Gateway to Ruin!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come across an expansive berry orchard on the way to Lilypad Town and Piplup falls in love with the orchard owner's Marill!
episodes.title: Three Sides to Every Story!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have arrived at Dawn's home in Twinleaf Town, where festival planning is in full swing-and Dawn challenges her mom to a Pokémon Contest Battle!
episodes.title: Strategy Begins at Home!

episodes.synopsis: On the first day of the Twinleaf Festival, keynote speaker Professor Oak runs into some trouble when someone else tries to take his place!
episodes.title: A Faux Oak Finish!

episodes.synopsis: As the Twinleaf Festival winds down, our heroes encounter a Natu and a Xatu that provide them with a mysterious and puzzling adventure they'll never forget!
episodes.title: Historical Mystery Tour!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes participate in the Twinleaf Festival Battle Challenge-and first prize is a battle against Tower Tycoon Palmer from the Sinnoh Battle Frontier!
episodes.title: Challenging a Towering Figure!

episodes.synopsis: Jessie, James, and Meowth lure our heroes inside Team Rocket's new state-of-the-art secret base, but it can't protect them from the antics of a mischievous Togepi!
episodes.title: Where No Togepi Has Gone Before!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue toward Lilypad Town and Dawn's next Pokémon Contest, an unexpected stop in a small village brings surprising new friends-and the Johto Festival!
episodes.title: An Egg Scramble!

episodes.synopsis: New friends Lyra and Khoury have joined our heroes on their journey, and soon Lyra's Marill wanders off unannounced and finds itself in trouble at the Valley Windworks!
episodes.title: Gone with the Windworks!

episodes.synopsis: As Dawn's next Pokémon Contest in Lilypad Town draws near, our heroes, along with Lyra and Khoury, cross paths with an ornery, powerful, and irresistible Gible!
episodes.title: A Rivalry to Gible On!

episodes.synopsis: On the day of the Lilypad Town Pokémon Contest, an out-of-sorts "Jessilina" forces James and Meowth to take emergency action!
episodes.title: Dressed for Jess Success!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Dawn are preparing to have a Tag Battle with their friends Lyra and Khoury, but Team Rocket has other plans!
episodes.title: Bagged Then Tagged!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Sunyshore City for Ash's next Gym battle, our heroes come across two Trainers who are brother and sister-and who have some troubling family issues!
episodes.title: Try for the Family Stone!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes' journey to Sunyshore City comes to an unexpected stop when Pikachu and Piplup get stuck on each other-literally!
episodes.title: Sticking with Who You Know!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes take a break on their way to Sunyshore City, they again cross paths with Team Galactic, whose evil plans finally begin to reveal themselves!
episodes.title: Unlocking the Red Chain of Events!

episodes.synopsis: Now that the villains of Team Galactic have everything they need to accomplish their evil plan, is there any way our heroes can stop them?
episodes.title: The Needs of the Three!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes battle against Team Galactic and its quest to build a new world order, the fate of the Sinnoh region and the entire world hangs in the balance!
episodes.title: The Battle Finale of Legend!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes discover a buried treasure chest in the forest, little do they realize the disaster that waits for them inside it!
episodes.title: The Treasure Is All Mine!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Dawn's next Pokémon Contest in Daybreak Town, our heroes meet an Air Battle Master, who presents Ash's Gliscor with a challenge-and an opportunity!
episodes.title: Mastering Current Events!

episodes.synopsis: As Dawn prepares for her Double Battle Contest in Daybreak Town, a little help from her friends brings some new and surprising inspiration!
episodes.title: Double-Time Battle Training!

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Dawn, and Brock meet an elderly woman training an Altaria (which Team Rocket wants to steal, of course), while a curious Gible is keeping an eye on everyone!
episodes.title: A Meteoric Rise to Excellence!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Barry both want to catch the Gible who's been following them around-and of course Team Rocket has an eye on it as well!
episodes.title: Gotta Get a Gible!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes must confront a Magnezone and Metagross that are angry about something and threatening the survival of an entire town!
episodes.title: Regaining the Home Advantage!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Daybreak Town and Dawn's next Pokémon Contest, our heroes meet a Pokémon Martial Artist who has a valuable lesson for Ash!
episodes.title: Short and to the Punch!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet a Trainer whose style is very different from Ash's, and the two of them have a unique competition to compare those styles!
episodes.title: A Marathon Rivalry!

episodes.synopsis: When Dawn arrives in Daybreak Town for her next Pokémon Contest, she finds an old rival waiting to challenge her-and Ash and Brock learn something new about their friend!
episodes.title: Yes, in Dee Dee It's Dawn!

episodes.synopsis: The Daybreak Town Pokémon Contest is heating up after the first round, and Dawn and Ursula find themselves forming a rivalry for the ages!
episodes.title: Playing the Performance Encore!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket comes up with a brand-new strategy for stealing Pokémon. But hold on-Ash's Monferno responds to the dire situation in an unexpected and fiery way!
episodes.title: Fighting Ire with Fire!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's Gible is working so hard to master its Draco Meteor attack, but it keeps going off course and hitting Piplup-and Piplup has just about had enough!
episodes.title: Piplup, Up and Away!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has arrived in Sunyshore City for his next Gym battle-but Gym Leader Volkner has decided he's not accepting any more challengers!
episodes.title: Flint Sparks the Fire!

episodes.synopsis: The Team Rocket trio want to steal Sunyshore Tower, and they come up with a novel way to do it!
episodes.title: The Fleeing Tower of Sunyshore!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes agree to substitute for Dawn's mother, Johanna, in teaching a Pokémon class, one of their students ends up teaching Dawn a valuable lesson!
episodes.title: Teaching the Student Teacher!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes prepare for Dawn's entry into the Grand Festival and Ash's rematch with Gym Leader Volkner, they meet a mysterious girl with a sick Shaymin who needs help!
episodes.title: Keeping in Top Forme!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their Sinnoh region journey, they come across a determined, upbeat Pokémon Ranger on a mission to capture a rare Heatran!
episodes.title: Pokémon Ranger: Heatran Rescue!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes attempt to help a young Trainer named Roland recover his stolen Pokémon, they discover his mentor is none other than Bertha of the Elite Four!
episodes.title: An Elite Coverup!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Grand Festival, our heroes are befriended by a royal princess with a familiar face and an unusual request!
episodes.title: Dawn of a Royal Day!

episodes.synopsis: Doing some special training as the Grand Festival approaches, Dawn discovers that her new friend Togekiss has a unique approach to battling!
episodes.title: With the Easiest of Grace!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Lake Valor and the Grand Festival, our heroes come across a tough Trainer with a pair of incredible Ditto!
episodes.title: Dealing With a Fierce Double Ditto Drama!

episodes.synopsis: It's the opening of the Grand Festival, and the first round is an amazing array of familiar and not-so-familiar faces!
episodes.title: Last Call-First Round!

episodes.synopsis: The Battle Stage of the Grand Festival is under way, and the first pairing is none other than Dawn and her feisty rival, Ursula!
episodes.title: Opposites Interact!

episodes.synopsis: As the field competing in the Grand Festival gets whittled down, some very familiar faces emerge for the final four - and then, the final two!
episodes.title: Coming Full - Festival Circle!

episodes.synopsis: Friends and rivals Dawn and Zoey are facing off in the final round of the Grand Festival! Who will become Top Coordinator?
episodes.title: A Grand Fight for Winning!

episodes.synopsis: Meowth is separated from Team Rocket and meets a beautiful Glameow! Could this be the end of his criminal career?
episodes.title: For the Love of Meowth!

episodes.synopsis: The battle for Ash's eighth Gym badge is at hand in Sunyshore City, and Volkner promises a challenge for our hero like none before!
episodes.title: The Eighth Wonder of the Sinnoh World!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has qualified for the Sinnoh League, and our heroes soon discover that the road to the competition is full of old friends!
episodes.title: Four Roads Diverged in a Pokémon Port!

episodes.synopsis: As they continue their trek via ferry to the Sinnoh League, our heroes come across a most unusual treasure hunter on a most unusual treasure hunt!
episodes.title: Bucking the Treasure Trend!

episodes.synopsis: On the eve of the Sinnoh League competition, Ash runs into some unexpected challenges while deciding which Pokémon to use!
episodes.title: An Old Family Blend!

episodes.synopsis: As the Sinnoh League competition gets under way on Lily of the Valley Island, Ash faces an old friend, the Pokémon bard Nando, in the first round!
episodes.title: League Unleashed!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's rivals Barry and Paul are battling it out in the third round of the Sinnoh League, while Ash prepares to face Conway, a fellow student from Pokémon Summer Academy!
episodes.title: Casting a Paul on Barry!

episodes.synopsis: It's Ash versus Conway in their third-round match at the Sinnoh League, and their battling styles have never been more distinctly different!
episodes.title: Working on a Right Move!

episodes.synopsis: The quarterfinal round of the Sinnoh League has arrived-and Ash and Paul are ready to face off in a rematch of their 6-on-6 full battle!
episodes.title: Familiarity Breeds Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: As the Sinnoh League quarterfinals continue, the full battle between Ash and Paul brings their rivalry to levels previously only imagined!
episodes.title: A Real Rival Rouser!

episodes.synopsis: The quarterfinal battle between Ash and Paul is building to a fever pitch, and with it, some surprising revelations between them!
episodes.title: Battling a Thaw in Relations!

episodes.synopsis: In the Sinnoh League semifinals, Ash faces Tobias, a Trainer he's heard a lot about during the competition-because Tobias has the incredibly powerful Mythical Pokémon Darkrai on his team!
episodes.title: The Semi-Final Frontier!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes make their way to Twinleaf Town via ferry, a group of injured Pokémon challenges Brock to develop new skills, giving him new ideas for the future!
episodes.title: The Brockster Is In!

episodes.synopsis: Before going their separate ways, our heroes take a moment in Twinleaf Town to remember happy times they've spent together and plan for happy times sure to come!
episodes.title: Memories are Made of Bliss!
